headline: South Africa High Court Sets Aside National Lottery Licence Award
summary: Sizekhaya will continue operating South Africa's National Lottery while Trade Minister Parks Tau reconsiders the licence award after the High Court set aside the original process.
why: The South African National Lottery is a high-value concession with significant licensing fees and commercial revenues managed under government oversight.

impacts.name: South Africa
impacts.why: Licensing disputes affect regulatory certainty for concession operators.
